partial_and_async_cases.case: No Sync adopted: independently close each actual cache/channel handle
Sync constructor throws: retained cache/channel obligations remain callable
Connection acquisition pending on cancellation: disposal awaits original acquisition settlement, then disposes any real returned handle
Connection acquisition rejects: state not-acquired means no handle transferred; original constructor remains owner, original preparation exception retained by original task
Synchronous abort reentry: pass reserved before abort, immediate abort outcome retained
Any independent async obligation still pending: all other obligations have started; repeats share in-flight pass, no timeout success or duplicate attempt
Late adopted Sync after synchronous constructor reentry: next microtask pass includes actual registered handle
Repeated permanent unsubscribe/cache/channel failure: live cleanup obligation retained, admission cannot reopen
Callback directly returning the current disposal pass: reject self-dependency; do not mark role fulfilled
Successful cleanup after a failed attempt: diagnostics retain original first/latest causes while command state advances only after real return

limitations: No native/task disposal, transport auth/security, storage-deletion or fixture/runtime qualification claimed.
Original cache scope clearing is best-effort by its existing API; command fulfillment is not a physical storage-deletion receipt.
An arbitrary foreign async callback waiting on its own cleanup outcome may remain pending; no timeout or false terminal state is manufactured.
Snapshot original API private custody source is exact efddb offer; its new reset concurrency ordering finding remains pending original-owner repair/review.
failed_preparation_custody: Original one preparation reservation retains the actual lifetime before constructors/awaits; source-identity cleanup retry remains reachable even when no ports return. It never retries preparation or resets closed state.
